history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send a picture message. Can you help me get it working again?

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing no service on your phone. Let's try to get this resolved quickly. To assist you, I’ll need to check your account and line status.

Could you please provide your phone number or your full name and date of birth? This will help me locate your account and investigate the issue.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send messages or use data.

Would you like me to resume your line now so you can regain service? If you know the reason for the suspension or if it was a mistake, please let me know.
I didn't know my line was suspended. Can you tell me why that happened, and what I need to do to get it working again?

It appears your line is suspended, but there is no recorded reason or suspension start date in our system. This could be due to a technical error or an unrecorded account action.

To get your service working again, I can resume your line immediately. There is usually no additional action required unless there is an outstanding bill or another account issue, but your account status shows as active and in good standing.

Would you like me to proceed and reactivate your line now?
Yes, please go ahead and reactivate my line.

I attempted to reactivate your line, but it cannot be resumed because the contract for your line ended on 2024-11-30. This is likely why your service was suspended.

To restore your service, you will need to renew your contract or select a new plan. Would you like information on available plans or assistance with renewing your contract? Let me know how you’d like to proceed, and I’ll guide you through the next steps.

tool_observations.error: Line LN-8830142 cannot be resumed because its contract end date (2024-11-30) is in the past.

history.content: Oh, I see. Can you show me what plans are available so I can pick a new one?

I currently do not have direct access to the full list of available plans, but I can provide details about your previous plan, "Advantage 50GB," which included 50GB of data for $65 per month, with additional data available at $5 per GB.

Would you like to renew this same plan, or would you prefer that I connect you with a human agent who can provide the latest plan options and help you choose the best one for your needs? Let me know how you’d like to proceed!
I'd like to see all the latest plan options, not just my old one. Please connect me with a human agent who can help me pick the best plan.
I will connect you with a human agent who can provide you with all the latest plan options and help you choose the best one to restore your service. Please hold on for a moment while I transfer you.

arguments.summary: Customer's line is suspended due to contract expiration. Customer wants to see all the latest plan options and needs assistance choosing the best plan to restore service.
